description: Every industry/livelihood domain not shipped with real data in this release, with the reason and what would unblock it. Mirrors Package001_Geography, Package002_Education, and Package003_Healthcare's acquisition_backlog.json convention: no domain ships guessed or placeholder rows just to appear complete.
environment_blocker_affecting_all_items: This session's organizational egress policy blocked direct WebFetch to .gov.in/.ac.in/.nic.in domains (confirmed HTTP 403 policy denial, re-tested live immediately before collection began). All RC1 datasets were collected via WebSearch snippets only. Government DIC/MSME/PMFME project-profile PDFs were located by URL in several cases but their content could only be seen via search snippet, not direct read -- this is the clearest example of a gap that would likely close with restored WebFetch access.

blocked_or_queued_domains.reason: Extremely large and fragmented category (handloom, powerloom, garment units, tailoring) spanning both traditional and industrial scales; no tractable narrow slice was identified this session that wouldn't require either massive scope or risk of shallow/unverifiable rows.

known_dataset_specific_gaps.gap: 8 of 13 rows have typical_investment_range_summary as PENDING_VERIFICATION -- no government project-profile-grade source was found. No government figure found at all for coconut cold-pressed oil or TG/AP-scale seed processing. PMFME's AP-specific model-DPR archive (pmfmeap.org/model-micro-dprs) was located by URL but not fully mined this session.

typical_investment_range_summary is PENDING_VERIFICATION for all 12 rows -- no credible government/NASSCOM costing source with a specific figure was found. No AP-specific women-in-tech scheme exists (WE-HUB is Telangana-only). TG/AP-specific Shops & Establishment/Professional Tax thresholds unverified.

No authoritative investment figures for most trades (only Carpenter is confirmed PM Vishwakarma-covered among the 9 trades researched). No named formal training body found for Aluminium Fabrication or Borewell Drilling. AP-specific electrical licensing rules unverified (only Telangana's 2018 Electrical Licensing Regulations confirmed).

The relationship between Telangana's older T-IDEA/T-PRIDE framework and the new 2024 MSME Policy is unresolved -- conflicting subsidy figures were found and left PENDING_VERIFICATION rather than guessed. No confirmed APIIC rename found (an old 'CIAP' legal reference was checked but not adopted as an active change).

Facebook Marketplace, named in the package brief's own examples, was checked and confirmed NOT officially launched in India -- documented explicitly. No unified AP-wide homestay policy document was found (only a Visakhapatnam pilot). Exact eNAM Telangana/AP farmer counts and Telangana homestay fees trace to secondary sources only. WhatsApp Business API pricing and CSC/ODOP entry-investment figures were not found this session.
